anna_dialogue.text:
Hi, I am Anna. 
Your personal secretary.

anna_dialogue.name: Anna
anna_dialogue.title: Office Secretary
anna_dialogue.text: Our AI model has deployed at different locations in the city to solve the manpower shortage problem.

anna_dialogue.name: Anna
anna_dialogue.title: Office Secretary
anna_dialogue.text:
As you can see, there still has lots of problem need to solved. 
So, we should find out what problem need to be solved.

anna_dialogue.name: Anna
anna_dialogue.title: Office Secretary
anna_dialogue.text:
I will help your to find out the problems. 
Let's start from collecting some evidences.

anna_dialogue.name: Anna
anna_dialogue.title: Office Secretary
anna_dialogue.text: Talk with the local residence (By clicking the icon on the map) is a good method to investigate the problems.
